Response variable/Predictor variable.reasoning: This header names the variable or trait being measured or predicted in the model.

$\\Delta$ AICc.reasoning: This header represents a statistical measure (Akaike Information Criterion difference).

Weight ( $w_i$ ).reasoning: This header represents a statistical weight or proportion assigned to a model.

Intercept ( $\\alpha$ ).reasoning: This header names a statistical parameter (the intercept) of the model.
